title: OMIR Episode (R1)
description: A bounded experience — the raw event from which MemoryRecords, Entities, and Relationships are derived. The episodic backbone of the graph. OMM level 3.

source.description: What kind of input produced this episode.

eventTime.description: When the original event occurred (event time).

createdAt.description: When this episode was ingested (ingestion time).

boundaryStrength.description: EP-4: prediction-error / Bayesian-surprise magnitude at this episode's boundary (event segmentation). Where memory is structured; a segmentation cue for downstream consolidation. OMM-0.

boundaryReason.description: EP-4: why the cut was made (open vocabulary, e.g. 'topic_shift', 'temporal_gap', 'actor_change'). Promotable to a CodeableConcept under Theme A. OMM-0.
